attempts.text: {"test_cases": [{"id": "TC1", "title": "Test cancelling an order placed within 24 hours", "type": "positive", "preconditions": "The order was placed within the last 24 hours and the customer is logged in.", "steps": ["Go to the order history page.", "Select an order that was placed within the last 24 hours.", "Click the 'Cancel' button for the selected order.", "Verify the order status changes to 'Cancelled'."], "expected_result": "The order status changes to 'Cancelled' and a cancellation email is sent to the customer.", "covers": ["AC1"]}, {"id": "TC2", "title": "Test cancelling an order that has already been shipped", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "The order has already been shipped.", "steps": ["Go to the order history page.", "Select an order that has already been shipped.", "Attempt to click the 'Cancel' button for the selected order."], "expected_result": "The order cannot be cancelled and a message is displayed saying 'This order has already been shipped and cannot be cancelled.'", "covers": ["AC2"]}, {"id": "TC3", "title": "Test cancelling an order and verifying the cancellation email", "type": "positive", "preconditions": "The order was placed within the last 24 hours and the customer is logged in.", "steps": ["Go to the order history page.", "Select an order that was placed within the last 24 hours.", "Click the 'Cancel' button for the selected order.", "Verify that a cancellation email is sent to the customer."], "expected_result": "A cancellation email is sent to the customer and the order status changes to 'Cancelled'.", "covers": ["AC1", "AC3", "AC4"]}] }
